_comment: FIX-Task-63 — LEGACY OUT-OF-BAND EXCEPTION RECORD. These are staging schema changes that were applied with NO committed migration file behind them (MCP `apply_migration` calls, dashboard SQL, or an in-session adaptation that was never written back). The goal is NOT to rewrite history — it is to make every exception VISIBLE and TIME-BOUNDED, so a future one cannot hide inside a pile of unexplained ledger rows. `scripts/migrations/ledger-audit.mjs` prints these instead of reporting the rows as unmanaged, and flags any entry past its `expiresAt`.

exceptions.reason: Ledger row whose `version` is an APPLY TIMESTAMP, not the filename prefix. The repo file is 20260918000009_fix_task_61_item_images_bucket_mime_alignment.sql and its effect was ALREADY live (allowed_mime_types contained heic/heif, file_size_limit 10485760) before the apply was requested. Provenance unresolved: a parallel session or a manual dashboard apply.
exceptions.reconciliationTask: FIX-Task-63 (record only — no re-apply; re-applying is a no-op by design)
exceptions.reconciliation: matched-to-file-by-NAME (the ledger's version column is not a filename prefix on this project)

exceptions.reason: FIX-Task-62's lockdown migration failed on staging (its literal anchor did not match staging's wrapped body text), so a whitespace-tolerant ADAPTED body was applied in-session. No file of that name has ever existed in the repo (grep: 0 hits) — i.e. live staging was ahead of the chain.
exceptions.reconciliationTask: FIX-Task-63 Phase 3 — requires `20260918050000_...lockdown.sql` to be rewritten so it converges to the LIVE end state and is a no-op when re-applied

exceptions.reason: The FIX-Task-60 grants file FAILED on staging (atomic, nothing applied) because it targets public.search_listings(text,boolean,integer), a signature staging does not have. The chain has it; staging does not.
exceptions.reconciliationTask: FIX-Task-63 Phase 3 — per-signature existence guards, then apply
